summary: Avalon GloboCare Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a securities purchase agreement with an accredited investor for 400 shares of Series F Convertible Preferred Stock at $1,000 stated value ($400,000 aggregate) plus 200,000 Commitment Shares. The preferred stock converts to common at $0.50/share, has mandatory redemption of 25% quarterly from October 2026 to January 2027 at 125% of stated value, and carries a 4.99% beneficial ownership limitation. The transaction is a private placement relying on Section 4(a)(2) and Rule 506(b). This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; it does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, activist campaign, spin-off, restructuring, or liquidation. There are no deal terms such as price per share, premium, or close date applicable to an M&A event. The filing simply describes the issuance of convertible preferred stock and commitment shares as financing, not a change-of-control or special corporate event. Therefore, it falls under the 'None' category.
